summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, containing a managers' transaction notice under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation. Konstanty Owczarek, a senior manager, acquired 37,405 shares at $15.9878 per share on the NYSE. The filing is a routine insider transaction report, not a corporate special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other event-driven category applies. The filing is a standard disclosure obligation for a foreign private issuer.
